headline: Baseline gate FAILED (docs/FRISCO_PROTOCOL.md section 6): C1 link flows (calibration), C3 speeds (calibration), C1 link flows (validation), C3 speeds (validation), C4 wave speed (calibration). No strategy recommendation may be made from this model.
reasons: Link flows, calibration days: GEH < 5 on 61.3 % of 840 station-hour comparisons pooled over 20 replicate(s) (per-replicate mean 61.3 %, 95 % interval 59.9 % to 62.7 %); the target is >= 85.0 %, short by 23.7 percentage points; hours anchored at the study period's start (1800 s).

Speeds, calibration days: RMSPE of 15-minute station mean speeds 29.3 % (mean over 20 replicate(s), 95 % interval 27.7 % to 30.9 %; point speeds at the stations, as a loop reads them); the target is at most 15.0 %, over by 14.3 percentage points (diagnostics: 5 min 31.7 %; 60 min 23.8 %).

Link flows, validation days: GEH < 5 on 56.3 % of 840 station-hour comparisons pooled over 20 replicate(s) (per-replicate mean 56.3 %, 95 % interval 54.8 % to 57.8 %); the target is >= 85.0 %, short by 28.7 percentage points; hours anchored at the study period's start (1800 s).

Speeds, validation days: RMSPE of 15-minute station mean speeds 33.4 % (mean over 20 replicate(s), 95 % interval 30.0 % to 36.8 %; point speeds at the stations, as a loop reads them); the target is at most 15.0 %, over by 18.4 percentage points (diagnostics: 5 min 36.8 %; 60 min 25.4 %).

Wave speed: a backward front in 15 of 20 replicate(s) (75.0 %; at least 80.0 % needed, a replicate without a front counting as a miss), short by 1 replicate(s); simulated backward wave speed 4.4 km/h, 95 % interval 4.3 to 4.5 km/h over those replicates (stack detector); the band is 14-22 km/h, outside it by 9.6 km/h; observed on the calibration days (detector cross-correlation): median 19.1 km/h from 7 of 13 station pairs.
